decision: Recommend certificate issuance as the next general INTEGIN authority boundary; defer evidence-export approval as a distinct post-certificate release-control capability, while preserving a future per-integration exception for submission-before-external-recognition.
positions_considered: Certificate-first: control the official inspection outcome before optional disclosure.
Export-first: control supporting-evidence release before an external recipient or authority receives it.
Adapter exception: a future external platform may require an approved evidence package before it accepts or recognizes a certificate.
accepted_concerns: Certificate issuance and evidence export are independent authority decisions; neither approval implies the other.
Sensitive evidence must not become publicly or externally accessible merely because a certificate is issued.
Future external adapter policy must be configurable without rewriting the local certificate lifecycle.
rejected_or_overridden_concerns: Treating export approval as the universal prerequisite is rejected because normal client/site verification needs a certificate, not broad evidence disclosure.
Treating certificate issuance as permission to export evidence is rejected because recipient, purpose, privacy, and release scope remain separate decisions.
residual_risks: Owner approver roles, separation-of-duties matrix, and external-registration policy are not yet specified.
No external authority requirements or connector behavior has been proven.
Offline authority-signature verification for evidence provenance remains a separate boundary.
evidence_required_before_action: Owner confirmation of certificate-first implementation order and approval-role policy.
A bounded certificate lifecycle contract with eligibility, signatory separation, revocation, supersession, QR projection, and negative tests.
No external release or platform submission until the later export-approval authority path is explicitly designed and proven.
next_bounded_action: On owner confirmation, define the certificate issuance authority contract without implementing any external evidence export or external platform submission.
